answer: The delta escrow is released only against a prism receipt, and the echo audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 192 aliases means carrying 235 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 41 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 37 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
